A FEW THINGS YOU MAY BE WONDERING

Let’s make it clear.

Who can join the camp?

The organising team will publish the 2028 eligibility criteria and guidance for participants, volunteers and national teams before applications open.

When and where will the camp take place?

The 2028 camp is planned for Hungary. Exact dates and venue details will be shared once confirmed.

How can I register or support the camp?

Registration and donation links will appear here once the official channels are ready. This concept does not collect applications or payments.

Can I reduce the animations?

Yes. Use the motion button just below the opening section. The page also follows your device’s reduced motion preference.
